question: Should ClawHub adopt this `claw` package family and grouped manifest/storage contract before the upstream Claws RFC is accepted?
rationale: Although disabled and carefully staged, the patch creates durable exported schema and persisted-data contracts whose long-term shape depends on unresolved product, ownership, and upgrade decisions.

options.title: Wait for RFC acceptance
options.body: Keep this draft open as prototype evidence and merge only after the RFC contract is accepted or explicitly narrowed, followed by a rebase and refreshed proof.

options.title: Approve groundwork now
options.body: Explicitly sponsor this disabled-by-default schema and storage slice while accepting that later RFC changes may require migration or contract churn.

options.title: Narrow the first slice
options.body: Retain only internal validation experiments and defer the public package-family and persisted-model changes until acceptance.

recommendation.title: Wait for RFC acceptance
recommendation.body: Keep this draft open as prototype evidence and merge only after the RFC contract is accepted or explicitly narrowed, followed by a rebase and refreshed proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest visible discussion-based owner for the agent-centric Claws product and schema contract.
